        b(2) = ((((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - d(2)) + a(2)) = ((c(2) - d(2)) + a(2)) = ((d(2) - d(2)) + a(2)) = a(2)

        impossible m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) != 0
    by contra:
        ? b != c

        c(1) = b(1)
        c(2) = b(2)
        d(1) = ((((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - b(1)) + a(1)) = ((c(1) - b(1)) + a(1)) = ((b(1) - b(1)) + a(1)) = a(1)
        d(2) = ((((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - b(2)) + a(2)) = ((c(2) - b(2)) + a(2)) = ((b(2) - b(2)) + a(2)) = a(2)
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (a(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (a(1) - a(1)))) = 0

    (c(1) - d(1)) = (((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - d(1)) = (b(1) - a(1))
    (c(1) - b(1)) = (((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - b(1)) = (d(1) - a(1))
    (c(2) - d(2)) = (((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - d(2)) = (b(2) - a(2))
    (c(2) - b(2)) = (((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - b(2)) = (d(2) - a(2))
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(a, b)

    by def $f3::are_parallel_lines(a, b, d, c)
    by def $f3::are_parallel_lines(a, d, b, c)

    third(1) = ((p(1) + fourth(1)) - q(1))
    third(2) = ((p(2) + fourth(2)) - q(2))
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(q, p, r)
